issue.title: Reduce archive pair-index latency after census caching
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-j5.4.1 per plan:202611/archive_pair_census_perf_and_land.md.

Seven alternating baseline/HEAD runs, all exit 0 (baseline b97d8d4c; HEAD eba2bd59): capture-related 58.0/140.3 ms; capture-related -d 0 36.6/120.0 ms; ref list 164.5/268.9 ms; stats 163.1/215.7 ms. The target is at most max(25 ms, 15%) above baseline, so all four commands still miss.

Likely remaining cost: read-only callers reconstruct ArchivePairIndex from per-note facts and resolve the full vault on each invocation; stats also builds and resolves the full index. This is an inference from the hot-cache timings and current call paths. Preserve global ambiguity/conflict guarantees and fresh censuses for every mutating consumer.

task_type_fields.impact: capture-related feeds Bob Mac Capture Similar tasks after each settled draft; ref list and stats also pay the repeated global archive-index cost.
task_type_fields.repro: Build b97d8d4c and HEAD eba2bd59 with --profile local-install; alternate each binary for seven runs of the four BOB_DIR=~/bob commands listed in plan:202611/archive_pair_census_perf_and_land.md. The medians were 58.0/140.3 ms (capture-related), 36.6/120.0 ms (capture-related -d 0), 164.5/268.9 ms (ref list), and 163.1/215.7 ms (stats); each HEAD median exceeds max(25 ms, 15%) above baseline.

issue.creation_reason: Seven alternating release-profile runs on the live 6.7k-note vault still exceed the approved performance limits after the fact-only parallel census and read-only fingerprint cache. This follow-up will preserve pair safety while addressing the remaining latency in capture-related, ref list, and stats.

payload.description: Follow-up required by the approved archive-pair performance plan after the 60-second census cache still misses all four latency targets.
